headline: For centered unit-interval heavy U0 and arbitrary unequal opposite rank-one centered-cube banks, the exact target family alpha U0^2+beta(a.U)^2-gamma(b.V)^2 (alpha,beta,gamma>=1) has global density maximum at zero and norm at most K_cone=3.817292346... <= K_sec=3.875531924... <3sqrt(2).
